input.body:
label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

Thanks for the request. Today `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` in src/exportUtils.ts only lists "csv" and "xlsx", and `toDelimited` always joins fields with a comma, so there's no tab-delimited output option anywhere in the export pipeline.

Adding TSV support would mean extending `SUPPORTED_FORMATS`/`ExportFormat`/`CONTENT_TYPES` with a "tsv" variant, parameterizing the delimiter used in `toDelimited` (and updating `escapeField`'s `NEEDS_QUOTES` check to also cover tabs), and wiring the new format through the writers in src/export/scheduler.ts, src/api/reports.ts, and the format picker in src/components/ExportButton.tsx. This would also solve the comma-in-description problem you're hitting with the manual CSV-to-TSV conversion.

input.title: Add TSV as a supported report export format
input.body: File: src/exportUtils.ts. Add "tsv" to SUPPORTED_FORMATS and CONTENT_TYPES (e.g. "text/tab-separated-values; charset=utf-8"), and extend toDelimited (or add a delimiter parameter defaulting to comma) so TSV output joins fields with a tab instead of a comma, updating escapeField's NEEDS_QUOTES regex to also treat tab as a delimiter needing quoting. This lets report export offer TSV alongside CSV and XLSX, which the warehouse loader in the issue requires and avoids the manual CSV-to-TSV conversion that breaks on commas in descriptions.
